'BUG REPRO: buggy isTaskCompleted returns true for sentinel completion '

why: _amnestyDayCutoffUtc is a private top-level function, so no test file can import and call it; the 3 'projection amnesty' tests in Scenario A (basic cutoff, mid-day cutoff, program back-date anchor-clamp) each hand-retype the algorithm instead (one comment even says 'Mimic the production day-level cutoff'). If a future edit to the real function or the isAfter(anchor) clamp regresses, these 3 tests stay green because they only check their own copy. Partial mitigation: scheduler_providers_branches_test.dart's RA1/RA2 do drive the real allDailyTasksProvider for the non-program path, but the program-specific back-date anchor-clamp scenario here has no confirmed real-path coverage elsewhere.
recommendation: Mark _amnestyDayCutoffUtc @visibleForTesting (or move it plus the clamp expression to a small pure function in domain/projection/) and have reorder_amnesty_test.dart's three amnesty tests call it directly instead of retyping the algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: reorder_amnesty_test.dart imports and calls the real cutoff/clamp function; no inline DateTime.utc(local.year, local.month, local.day) reimplementation remains in the test file.
A mutation flipping isAfter to isBefore in the anchor clamp (scheduler_providers.dart:683) fails this test file.

corrections: Quote 'final cutoff = DateTime.utc(...)' is at line 223, not 221 (content is real, just mis-cited by 2 lines).

The reorder_amnesty_test.dart citation at line 221 is off by 2 lines — the quoted text `final cutoff = DateTime.utc(local.year, local.month, local.day);` is actually at line 223; line 221 is the tail of the 'Mimic the production day-level cutoff' comment. Immaterial to the finding's substance.
